$comment: This is not an MCP manifest; it is a static deep-link inventory. The protocol server is local and separate: see llms.txt, «For AI agents».
title: PreceptorOS · web · static deep-link inventory
generated_by: claude (terminal familia train), 2026-11-02. Replaces v1.0.0, whose six game actions lost their handler when the game was retired (corte D, 2026-10-28); trimmed under the Sovereign's «firmo todo» (2026-11-02).
declaration: Static inventory only. No network, no personal data, no runtime discovery. The web receives nothing from anyone (Reglamento (UE) 2024/1689 transparency-by-design, Art. 50).

actions.title: Open the map
actions.what: The global map: the floor and the live nodes. Tap or click a node to walk there; arrow keys choose a neighbour, Enter walks.

actions.title: Start a visit
actions.what: The welcome card: play now, signed on this device. The key is created on the device and never leaves it.

actions.title: Ask the guide
actions.what: The chat with the local guide. It answers only after the visitor chooses to download and verify the small model; until then it says it is asleep.
actions.needs: optional local model download, chosen by the visitor

actions.title: Get the app
actions.what: Install the app on this device, with the fingerprint to check each file.

global_guards.no_network: The web performs zero new network requests; the rack pushes receipts to the repo (G4, separate piece).
global_guards.no_personal_data: No personal data in this manifest. Coordinates are in-world only.
global_guards.a11y: Mouse, keyboard, touch; world audible; controls >= 44 px.
global_guards.determinism: Same seed and input = same result; the suite can go red.
global_guards.piece_budget: Each piece < 16 KiB, vanilla JS, no build in public/.

open_firmos: receipt date: UTC or game cycles? (Soberano decides)
receipt push identity: receipts branch only, never main direct (Soberano decides)
